findings.issue: The vocab list teaches 値 only as あたい ('preço, valor'), but the example sentence immediately after reads it ね (このぬのはねがたかい). あたい means 'valor/mérito', not 'preço'; 値 = 'preço' is read ね. Worse, 根 (ね) was just taught in the same list, so the learner will misparse ねがたかい.
findings.current: <vocab ref="vocab:値"/> (あたい) - preço, valor. […] <jp reading="このぬのはねがたかい">この布は値が高い</jp>
findings.suggested: 値 (ね / あたい) - preço (ね), valor/mérito (あたい). Em この布は値が高い, 値 lê-se ね (não confunda com 根).

findings.issue: 真っ赤 (まっか) is a な-adjective/noun, not an adverb; the lesson calls it an 'advérbio de intensidade' in the description, objectives and body heading, yet exercise 3's explanation correctly treats it as adjetivo な — an internal contradiction. 万一 and 丸で also do not express 'intensidade'.
findings.current: os advérbios de intensidade 益々 e 真っ赤
findings.suggested: o advérbio de intensidade 益々 e o adjetivo な 真っ赤

findings.issue: 真っ赤 (まっか) is classified as an adverb. It is a na-adjective/noun (the lesson's own exercise 3 explanation says "como adjetivo な"), so the description states a false grammatical fact and contradicts the lesson.
findings.current: e os advérbios de intensidade 益々 e 真っ赤
findings.suggested: o advérbio de intensidade 益々 e o adjetivo な 真っ赤

findings.issue: Same misclassification: 真っ赤 is listed among "advérbios". 全く, 益々 and 丸で are adverbs, but 真っ赤 is a na-adjective (used as 真っ赤な顔), as the lesson itself teaches in exercise 3.
findings.current: Empregar advérbios de intensidade total como 全く, 益々, 真っ赤 e 丸で.
findings.suggested: Empregar palavras de intensidade total: os advérbios 全く, 益々 e 丸で e o adjetivo な 真っ赤.

findings.issue: The section heading groups 真っ赤 under "Advérbios de intensidade total", but 真っ赤 is a na-adjective, not an adverb; the checklist repeats the same wrong label.
findings.current: <heading level="3"><text>Advérbios de intensidade total</text></heading> ... <vocab ref="vocab:真っ赤"/><text> (まっか) - vermelho vivo, todo corado.</text>
findings.suggested: Heading: "Palavras de intensidade total" (advérbios 全く / 益々 / 丸で / 万一 e o adjetivo な 真っ赤)

findings.issue: 値 is taught only with the reading あたい glossed as "preço", but the example sentence right below reads it as ね (このぬのはねがたかい). あたい means "valor/worth"; the "preço" sense in 値が高い is ね, so the learner is given a reading that does not match the example.
findings.suggested: (ね / あたい) - preço (ね, como em 値が高い); valor, mérito (あたい).
